Superlodge in New Castle
Superlodge in New Castle is a convenient and affordable place to stay for travelers visiting northern Delaware. Located at 1213 West Ave, New Castle, Delaware 19720, this 4-star budget hotel offers comfortable accommodations, practical amenities, and easy access to downtown Wilmington, Philadelphia International Airport, and many of the area's most popular attractions.
Whether you are planning a business trip, a family vacation, a weekend getaway, or an overnight stop while traveling through Delaware, Superlodge in New Castle delivers a simple and relaxing stay with everything you need. Guests appreciate the hotel's free WiFi, complimentary parking, non-smoking rooms, air conditioning, family-friendly accommodations, and accessible facilities.
For visitors searching for hotels in New Castle that combine value, location, and convenience, Superlodge is one of the best places to stay in New Castle. The property is located close to major highways, making it easy to reach Wilmington, Newark, Philadelphia, and the surrounding Delaware attractions.
About the Hotel
Superlodge in New Castle offers a practical and welcoming atmosphere designed for both short and extended stays. The hotel has recently undergone updates and improvements, creating a cleaner, more modern experience while still maintaining the affordability that travelers want.
From the moment you arrive, the hotel provides a straightforward and stress-free experience. A 24-hour front desk is available for late arrivals, early departures, and any assistance guests may need during their stay. The staff is friendly and helpful, offering recommendations on nearby restaurants, local attractions, and transportation options.
The property is especially popular among travelers who need a hotel near Wilmington, a convenient stop along Interstate 95, or a comfortable base for exploring northern Delaware. Because Superlodge in New Castle is close to Interstate 295, Route 13, and Interstate 495, it is easy to travel between Delaware, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New Jersey.
Unlike many budget hotels in the area, Superlodge offers spacious rooms, free onsite parking, and family-friendly accommodations. The hotel's location near shopping, restaurants, local businesses, and transportation routes makes it a practical choice for both business and leisure travelers.
Guests staying at Superlodge also enjoy a quieter setting compared to downtown Wilmington hotels while still being within a short drive of the city's offices, entertainment, and dining.
Rooms & Accommodation
Superlodge in New Castle features a range of room types designed to accommodate solo travelers, couples, families, and business guests.
King Room
The King Room is an excellent choice for solo travelers, couples, and business visitors. These rooms feature one large king-size bed and offer a comfortable setting for a restful night's sleep.
Inside the room, guests will find:
Free high-speed WiFi
Air conditioning and heating
Flat-screen TV with cable channels
Mini refrigerator and microwave
Desk and workspace
Telephone
Hairdryer
Iron and ironing board available on request
Private bathroom with shower and complimentary toiletries
The king room is ideal for business travelers who want a quiet, comfortable space with room to work and relax.
Double Queen Room
Families and small groups often prefer the Double Queen Room, which includes two queen beds and extra space for additional guests. These rooms are ideal for parents traveling with children, friends on a road trip, or guests attending events in Wilmington or New Castle.
The room includes all the same conveniences as the king room, including air conditioning, free WiFi, a microwave, refrigerator, and flat-screen television.
Family Rooms
Superlodge in New Castle also offers family rooms for larger groups who need more sleeping space. These rooms provide a practical layout and are especially useful for guests staying multiple nights.
Families appreciate having extra room to spread out after a day of sightseeing, shopping, or visiting nearby attractions.
Accessible Rooms
The hotel provides ADA-accessible guest rooms for travelers with mobility needs. These rooms include wider entrances, accessible bathrooms, and convenient layouts.
Accessible parking spaces are also available close to the hotel entrance, making Superlodge one of the more convenient places to stay in New Castle for guests who require additional accessibility.
In-Room Features
Every room at Superlodge in New Castle is designed to provide a practical and comfortable stay. Standard room features include:
Free WiFi throughout the room
Climate control with air conditioning and heating
Cable television
Microwave and mini refrigerator
Daily housekeeping
Desk and work area
Comfortable bedding and blackout curtains
Non-smoking room options
These amenities help guests feel at home whether they are staying for one night or several days.
Amenities & Facilities
Superlodge in New Castle offers a variety of amenities that help make each stay more convenient and enjoyable.
Free WiFi
Complimentary WiFi is available throughout the property, including all guest rooms and common areas. Whether you are checking emails, planning your itinerary, joining a virtual meeting, or streaming entertainment, the hotel's free internet service keeps you connected.
Complimentary Parking
One of the most valuable features of Superlodge is its free onsite parking. Guests can park without additional charges, and the hotel also offers large parking areas suitable for RVs, buses, and trucks.
Travelers arriving by car appreciate the convenience of having secure parking available directly outside the hotel.
